## How to use this deck {.smaller}

This deck holds all slides of the course day, in the order of the timetable. Use it on the room screen for the whole day.

- Each slot starts with a title slide. It names the activity, the time, the duration, the format, and the lead.
- The slides of a slot follow the title slide.
- Press `O` for the overview. Press `?` for all keyboard shortcuts.

The times come from `data/schedule.yml`. Show the other decks in a second window during the Lens inputs.

::: notes
Open the deck before the participants arrive. Press `F` for full screen.
:::
